description: Transportation Secure Data Center (TSDC) is a data resource listed in opentransportdata (ITSLeeds), a curated list of open transport datasets, published or maintained by National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL). Free access to detailed transportation data from a variety of travel surveys and studies conducted across the United States. Coverage: United States, various states. The opentransportdata README lists it in its table of datasets. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the page read. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support travel demand and road safety analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-opentransportdata-itsleeds.
